implementedFindings.finding: Repeated paragraphs, captions and headings made mobile pages lengthy. The Ambattur page included an unfinished neighbourhood placeholder and unverified proximity/budget claims.
implementedFindings.fix: Replaced paragraphs with brief useful copy, removed the unfinished claims, condensed tables/cards, collapsed FAQs by default, tightened spacing and made the mobile footer more compact.
implementedFindings.verification: Production copy comparison plus responsive browser review.

implementedFindings.finding: Project overview and local pages overlapped in their SEO focus; testimonial metadata was managed separately.
implementedFindings.fix: Centralized distinct page intent in content/seo.ts. Applied accurate location-specific BHK titles and descriptions, with relevant visible headings and concise copy.
implementedFindings.verification: Every public page has one H1, one unique title and description, and one correct canonical; no noindex directive.

implementedFindings.finding: Residence markup described a specific property even though these are neighbourhood enquiry pages with illustrative imagery.
implementedFindings.fix: Changed the template to WebPage markup about the named Place. No invented prices, inventory, approval status or review ratings.
implementedFindings.verification: JSON-LD is parsed on all routes and checked for the appropriate page type; no Residence or Review markup.

implementedFindings.finding: Page metadata lacked explicitly configured social images; some custom page templates lacked breadcrumb/page structured data.
implementedFindings.fix: Added a branded 1200x630 social preview, complete Open Graph/Twitter data, linked WebSite/WebPage entities and missing breadcrumbs. ContactPage and projects CollectionPage reflect their actual purpose.
implementedFindings.verification: Browser metadata assertions, schema parsing, HTTP image checks and visual review.

implementedFindings.finding: Meta keywords were emitted even though Google does not use them; sitemap lastModified was reset to the current build date.
implementedFindings.fix: Removed the unused meta-keywords output and omitted lastModified until genuine per-page dates are tracked. Retained all 18 public canonical URLs and the robots sitemap reference. Normalized the configured origin to avoid duplicate slashes.
implementedFindings.verification: Browser/API tests check the sitemap, canonical URLs, robots reference and absence of meta keywords.

implementedFindings.finding: Long duplicate copy and ambiguous phone labels made navigation less direct.
implementedFindings.fix: Added relevant service/project links to the Ambattur hub, all-location links from detail pages, clear call/WhatsApp choices and a smaller footer that retains navigation and contact details.
implementedFindings.verification: All discovered internal page and fragment links resolve to existing pages and anchors. Forms, menus, carousel and chat regression checks pass.

copyComparison.method: Words in the server-rendered main element, excluding scripts, styles, header and footer. The projects overview count covers its initial streamed shell, not the deferred carousel. This is a copy comparison, not an SEO score or ranking signal.
